findings.text: the refusal cannot fire on any production route: gs.apply (nova/equilibrium/gs.py:34), the jitted reduced map (nova/equilibrium/reduced_newton.py:353) and the certificate's jitted jvp (benchmarks/solovev_certificate.py:996) all pass tracers, so qualify_cell_current_moments returns indices=() and a non-finite cell is still zeroed silently, which is the behaviour the answered blocking finding was about, on the only route that produced the original non-finite action.

the fragment and the docstring at forward_operator.py:438-439 claim the offending cell is reported by the concrete evaluation that reads the same state, but no concrete evaluation of these moments exists in the solve path; the certificate benchmark jits the only reader (benchmarks/solovev_certificate.py:996).

test_a_traced_state_is_qualified_without_a_value_to_judge feeds a fully finite traced state (scale * ones), so it never exercises qualification of a non-finite cell under trace and cannot fail if the traced branch stopped zeroing the bad cell; the production route is the traced one.
